extracted.stage: Ongoing financial remedy proceedings, through to settlement or trial
extracted.summary: A partner at Beckford & Olsen Family Law enquires about £25,000 of funding for a client's representation in ongoing financial remedy proceedings where the matrimonial pot is around £194,500 and the other side controls the liquid assets.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for your client's financial remedy proceedings. We have noted the £25,000 requested and the matrimonial assets of approximately £194,500. To progress a review, we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and court dealing with the matter, the current procedural stage and any listed hearing dates, a breakdown of the costs the loan would cover, and details of the assets in dispute and your client's interest in them. Please also confirm your client's consent for us to correspond with you on her behalf. We will come back to you once we have had a chance to consider the information provided.
